claim_results.reason: The targeted original PDF passages support the five mathematical mappings. L01 supplies abstract scales and spectral multiplicity, with K_c/c satisfying its normalization; it supplies no sparse-family completeness theorem. L04 Proposition 2.14 is a sufficient quotient-independence criterion, while its GKN application requires the stated extension and quotient-basis hypotheses. Its v1 page-15 deficiency assertion is accurately flagged and not imported. L05 requires domain reflection invariance in addition to symmetric coefficients. L06 concerns the singular Friedrichs-Legendre model; the reported weight and interval inconsistencies occur in the originals. For every positive integer n, matching the Taylor polynomial through degree 2n-1 supplies the required local absolute continuity, preserves weighted highest-derivative integrability, and leaves the nonintegrable next ordinary derivative. The comparative note keeps this repair separate from any Krein-domain theorem. Journal and arXiv evidence are appropriately distinguished, subject to the metadata limitations below.

The sqrt(2) restriction map is onto and preserves the complex L2 norm. Both operator-domain inclusions hold: even extension requires g'(0)=0, odd extension requires h(0)=0, and these conditions ensure matching values and first derivatives at zero without distributional interface terms. The endpoint conditions give exactly the prescribed coupled Krein traces. Reflection preserves the full operator domain and commutes with the operator, so the reducing decomposition transports spectral projections and every stated Borel-function domain. Power norms transfer isometrically; negative scales require completion as stated. Both affine modes have eigenvalue c and the claimed norms. The x2, p4 and q6 domain checks are correct. No sparse-family density follows from this equivalence alone.

The auxiliary full-interval problems satisfy the supplied Grubb hypotheses: smooth strongly elliptic principal part, normal first-order local boundary operators, and positive bijective realizations. The endpoint estimate gives R_(c+4) >= (c+1)I; N_c >= cI. Reducing parity and comparison of lambda with lambda+4 transfer domains with constants depending on c and s. Grubb's Definition 2.1, Theorem 2.2 and Corollary 2.3 yield the asserted ordinary and critical thresholds. Triangular elimination of lower even derivatives works in both directions. At critical orders, the zero-extension cross integral gives the distance weight, and lower residuals have zero endpoint traces and bounded weighted norms by the stated Hardy estimate. This also establishes norm equivalence. The localized Fourier sequence proves failure of centre-trace continuity at equality and below. The x2, p4, q6 and affine checks agree with the dictionary; s=5/2 introduces no additional endpoint boundary layer. The supplied bridge avoids an unsupported mixed-boundary invocation.

The positive closed form on H1 has associated operator exactly K_c, giving D(K_c^(1/2))=H1. The spectral product criterion and the verified H2 estimate establish H_c^3=H3 intersect ker B with equivalent norms independently of the fractional dictionary. The complex three-trace map is onto via p0, p1 and p4. Leading-degree elimination proves the divisible-tail identity for all degrees. The cutoff estimates are valid through order three; the squared kernel constants are r^6/120, r^4/12 and r^2/2, and convergence uses the shrinking local L2 norm of f'''. For fixed delta, polynomial approximation followed by the fixed endpoint correction preserves divisibility and converges in the required topology. Choosing delta before the approximation index avoids exchanging limits. Thus the cofinite closure and codimension are exactly determined by retained indices 0,1,4. The p5 and q6 examples are correct. A prescribed cofinite index set is not identified with membership induced by an arbitrary closed space.

The regular maximal/minimal domains are H2/H2_0 and H4/H4_0, with boundary-quotient dimensions four/eight and deficiency indices (2,2)/(4,4). The product-domain argument gives D(K_c^2)={f in H4: Bf=B(f'')=0}. Both displayed Green forms and their isotropy on the selected boundary subspaces are correct. The four-trace matrix has determinant 15360; the divisible-tail matrix has determinant 2L^2 for the stated positive even L. Their finite-dimensional right inverses supply boundary corrections, with density requiring the separate approximation argument. The four cards preserve the operator, c>0, topology, critical-order and deletion restrictions, and their source hashes bind the supplied snapshots. The corrected proof explicitly retains p0 and p1 as eigenfunctions and limits non-eigenfunction status to n>=4.

Inspected and executed a byte-identical script copy in a temporary directory using SymPy 1.14.0. All 98 assertion records and all four rejected-counterfactual records exactly matched the supplied evidence. Independently recomputed the cutoff kernel constants, affine eigenmode identities, fourth-order Green-form derivative identity, weighted integral products, and finite Taylor-matching examples. Symbolic parameter identities were interpreted only on their declared admissible domains, including m>=2 where denominators contain m-1. These computations certify the stated algebraic checks, not Sobolev, interpolation, functional-calculus or infinite-dimensional closure results. All 35 input hashes matched before and after verification; source snapshots were not modified.

The current repair closes F1 and F2 independently of the earlier verdict. Direct calculation gives K_c p0=c p0 and K_c p1=c p1. For any polynomial eigenfunction of degree at least two, comparison of leading terms forces eigenvalue c and then p''=0, a contradiction. Direct PDF extraction and visual inspection place Definition 2.1/Theorem 2.2 on arXiv page 3 and Corollary 2.3/equation (2.7) on page 4; journal page 833 contains the corresponding statements. The journal front page states 27 October 2015. The unsupported publisher-search assertion of 26 October is explicitly withdrawn in both the revised note and manifest. All proposal proof hashes and correction after-hashes match the current exact inputs. This closure does not certify an entire source article.
